title: Helion Energy wordmark footer
description: A near-black footer: a newsletter email field with a small text button on the left, uppercase mono link groups on the right (three columns on desktop, two on phones), a row of copyright and social links spread edge to edge, and the brand name stretched across the full width as a giant graphite mono wordmark. Links underline on hover; social links dim to 60%.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class); the wordmark uses the dark `muted` tone
the wordmark is SVG text stretched with textLength, so any name fills the width without JavaScript
